Name: Mizu's Nature in the Valley Retexture
Author: MizuJakkaru
Description:
[center]﻿﻿[img]https://imgur.com/QO3hCLy.png[/img][/center]
This mod is largely a only a texture replacement for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30138]Nature in the Valley[/url], though tweaks were made to the in-game scaling to match with the new textures and for consistency. All the animals have been retextured to have a vanilla-style appearance. Beetles and butterfly (especially item sprites) were designed with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43024]Insects of Ferngill[/url] in mind and these textures pair nicely with that mod! No long description this time, this was just some spriting I was picking at while doing other animals. 

Future Plans:
[list]
[*]Net retexture[/*]
[*]Better animation for dragonfly wings[/*]
[*]Better item categories[/*]
[*]Additional critters![/*]
[/list][center][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/KY9I9jB.png[/img][/b][/center]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
3. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it the same way you install standalone mods, this mod doesn't overwrite anything in the NITV folders directly
4. You're ready to play!

To remove this mod, you can just delete it from your mod folder. Everything will revert to NITV's original graphics safely.

[center][img]https://imgur.com/5exTlaQ.png[/img][/center]
